name: Air Quality & Pollen
description: Air quality and UV worldwide, with pollen for Australia, Europe and beyond, and thunderstorm asthma.

settings.label: Bar shows
settings.description: Dials for how much the air and pollen need attention today. Where there is no pollen data, the air dial shows alone.

settings.label: AirHealth pollen apps (grass pollen and allergens)
settings.description: Enabled by default for Australian coordinates. Uses the free app service behind Melbourne, Canberra, Sydney and Perth pollen sites; coordinates select your service location. No premium route, API key or cookies are used. You can turn this source off in settings.

settings.label: EPA Victoria air quality
settings.description: Keyless ArcGIS mirror of EPA Victoria monitoring stations, used only for Victorian locations when AirHealth has no air-quality reading or is off. Station readings older than three hours are ignored; the mirror has not updated since 5 December 2025, so Open-Meteo supplies the reading until it does.

settings.label: Global air quality, UV and European pollen (Open-Meteo)
settings.description: CAMS model data: AQI, particulates, UV and gaseous pollutants worldwide, and grass, tree and weed pollen across Europe. No key required.

settings.label: Google Pollen API key (optional)
settings.description: Adds pollen for the United States and other countries outside AirHealth's and Open-Meteo's coverage. Create a key with the Pollen API enabled in Google Cloud (billing must be on; the monthly free quota covers this plugin's requests). Google's data is shown live and never stored.

settings.label: Use the shell's weather location
settings.description: Follows Settings > Weather. Turn off, or leave the shell's location unset, to use the coordinates below.

settings.label: Latitude
settings.description: Decimal degrees, negative south of the equator. Used when the shell has no weather location or the option above is off. Defaults to Melbourne.

settings.label: Longitude
settings.description: Decimal degrees, negative west of Greenwich. Defaults to Melbourne.

settings.label: Preferred EPA station
settings.description: Leave empty to use the closest station. A name such as "Melbourne CBD" pins the reading.

settings.label: Notify when air quality, pollen or UV is high
